verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no documented public API. The probes show only bot walls (an Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on both the www.nvsos.gov front door and the esos/orion filing portal, which turn keyless agents away. Absence of a documented API for an applicable capability is "none".
